reviews.title: Awesome team and app
reviews.text: I’ve been struggling for a long time and I’m going into college soon and really wanted to gain control before I left for college. I’m also broke so when I reached out to the Gracen team, without hesitation they offered me a year free trial! I’m already seeing promising results, it’s definitely working better than other methods I have tried.

reviews.title: Truly Christ Centered
reviews.text: I’ve encountered many apps that promise an empty, will power oriented approach to overcoming temptation. Gracen stands out. This is a truly Christ centered, God honoring app. As a university student I don’t have much money available to spend on subscriptions. After reaching out to the team about my situation, I was offered a 1 year free trial to see if the app was a good fit. Truly a generous and loving act that clearly shows the developer’s intentions. Unlike other companies, they are not in this for the money alone, Gracen is an app that truly seeks to make a difference and to bring others closer to Christ. I love that scripture and prayer are directly incorporated into the app’s interface and approach to recovery. I highly recommend giving it a try!

reviews.title: Amazing people and amazing app
reviews.text: I reached out to the team and told them I wasn’t able to afford the subscription. They gave me a year for free with no questions. I can’t express how much that means and it shows the owners truly care about the people using the app to help grow closer to god and leave the sinful life behind.

reviews.title: More engaging than Covenant Eyes
reviews.text: I love Gracen. I had Covenant Eyes for a year and it did little to nothing to truly target a fallen sinful heart. Gracen allows for much deeper community connection with others in the thick of the fight against our fallen flesh. You can add friends and chat with others in a way CE didn’t let me and there’s a great deal of encouragement and strength to be gained from that. Also, the SOS button feature is fantastic to get you through a moment of temptation with focused breathing, scriptural encouragement and guided prayer as well as prompts for physical activity and recentering your focus to overcome wrong desires. I really enjoy that in the set up you’re prompted to share your personal motivation for overcoming, then on the home page you’re reminded of that daily when you go through the devotional and recommitment. 10/10 5 stars all the way 🙌
